## Historical audit — S0325, chunk 2 of 2

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/H08/selection/bw_0017/1/trajectory.jsonl`. Only the supplied chunk is visible; the original task and earlier changes are not.

| Question | Visible evidence |
|---|---|
| Goal | **Inferred, not stated:** reproduce an industrial scene against reference landmarks. Build output compares window, machine, tank and conveyor projections with reference coordinates (line 29, characters [0,44271)). |
| Objects and materials | Render logs enumerate many separate Box, Rod and Ball objects. Build output reports assignments for green epoxy floor, stainless machinery/framework, bright duct/frame, painted tank and yellow guardrails, with metallic and roughness values. These are evidence of multiple meshes and material assignments, not verified appearance or textures (line 29, [0,44271)). |
| Connections and pose | No visible geometric test establishes whether parts connect correctly or whether object poses match the reference. Names and landmark labels are not independent verification (line 29, [0,44271)). |
| Camera and exploration | The build reports previous, chosen and trial-aim-down camera projections. For the chosen camera, window top is projected at (-0.089, 0.300) against reference (0.16, 0.34); other landmarks also differ. This is evidence of a comparison and candidate exploration, not proof of visual alignment or of who initiated it (line 29, [0,44271)). |
| Execution and validation | Step 3 built and rendered successfully, with return codes 0; Blender saved `scene.blend` and `final.png` after 16 samples. The render completed without timeout or memory-limit failure, and step 3 was selected (lines 28–30; line 29 [0,44271)). No image is supplied here, so lighting quality, framing, occlusion and visual fidelity remain unverified. |
| Teacher and changes | No teacher input, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption is visible in this chunk. Nor is a code diff: the completed build establishes the resulting assignments and reported camera comparisons, not which changes were made in this step (line 29, [0,44271)). |

**Outcome:** Technical build/render success and selection are observed. Formal task success, partial correctness or algorithm failure cannot be established from this chunk; there is no visible technical interruption or basis to call the patch empty. The step-3 render started with zero model calls and executions remaining (line 27), but that alone does not establish why the run ended.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, projected landmarks and material-assignment logs provide useful checks but do not replace image or geometry inspection. Task-specific unresolved questions include whether the off-frame window projection reflects a framing error, whether machinery and guardrail parts actually meet, and whether lighting and materials resemble the reference. The unseen earlier chunk may contain relevant context; no claim is made about it.
